comparison.objective: Land two decking bundles across three joists near a bearing end; candidate breaks and collects thread-insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load transport, handoff, squaring, and supported placement versus coaxial small-tool use, impact-force regulation, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Each bundle flat and square across at least three joists, within 40 mm model distance of the bearing, not stacked or mid-span versus four safe fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: Structural load-placement constraints are unrelated to insert finishing.
